meta.name: prioritize-features
meta.description: Prioritize a backlog of feature ideas based on impact, effort, risk, and strategic alignment with top 5 recommendations. Use when prioritizing a feature backlog, making scope decisions, or ranking product ideas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按影响、投入和战略对齐排序功能需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从一堆想法中选出最该做的功能
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize feature ideas by impact, effort, and strategic fit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to pick which features to build next

howto.what: 分析你提供的功能想法，根据影响、工作量、风险和战略契合度进行评分，并推荐优先级最高的前5个功能。
howto.when: 当你需要从一堆功能想法中选出最重要的几个，或者在做范围决策、给产品想法排序时。

say.text: 帮我给这些功能想法排个序，选出前5个。
say.note: Claude会要求你提供功能列表和评估标准。

say.text: 根据影响和努力程度，推荐最值得做的功能。
say.note: Claude会使用ICE或RICE框架进行评分。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your feature ideas, scores them based on impact, effort, risk, and strategic alignment, and recommends the top 5 features to pursue.
howto.when_en: When you need to prioritize a backlog of feature ideas, make scope decisions, or rank product ideas.

say_en.text: Rank these feature ideas and give me the top 5.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your feature list and criteria.

say_en.text: Recommend the most valuable features based on impact and effort.
say_en.note: Claude will use ICE or RICE scoring.
